ModMetaData.name: Advanced Plant Genetics
ModMetaData.author: IyedBecheikh
ModMetaData.description:
Plant genetics as a full progression path, from tribal seed saving to ultratech genome synthesis.
Every sown plant has a readable genome: nine loci with dominant and recessive alleles (growth, yield, fertility response, soil tolerance, light efficiency, cold and heat tolerance, blight resistance, vigor) plus special genes. Inheritance is Mendelian: purebred lines breed true, hybrids scramble, recessive traits hide and resurface. A genome capacity budget means you specialise: a hydroponic supercrop and a tundra crop are different designs.
[b]Tribal[/b] - Collect seed from your best plants, sow it, save seed at harvest. [b]Medieval[/b] - Crossing bench: cross or self-pollinate and keep the best of several offspring. Propagation bench: multiply any strain true to type. [b]Industrial[/b] - Genetic analyzer reveals hidden alleles; gene bank; tissue culture (1 packet to 12); mutagen chamber and colchicine polyploidy. [b]Spacer[/b] - Gene splicer edits loci from your allele library and splices genes across species; synthetic traits (circadian override, runners); autonomous seed synthesizer. [b]Ultratech[/b] - Genesis synthesizer: alleles up to +10, synthetic chromosomes, chemosynthetic and deathless plants, phytomining.
Wild-type farming stays exactly like vanilla: no seed micromanagement unless you choose a strain. Seed packets are tradeable and worth more with better genetics.
Optional: Progression: Agriculture (unlocking a crop also gives heirloom seed; seed packets can unlock their crop). Safe to add to an existing save.
